verdict.rationale: Rippling's own documentation explicitly states it automatically calculates and files federal, state, and local payroll taxes at the correct time and agency (rippling-docs-44, rippling-docs-40), directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of tax filing accuracy or remittance timeliness, and detail on how errors/penalties are handled beyond vendor claims (the CSV incident in rippling-comm-1/2 concerns payroll run delay, not tax filing failure, so it doesn't dispute this specific claim).
